title: Data Science and Machine Learning Platform for Health Analytics
raw_description: The BC Ministry of Health requires a vendor to deliver a cloud-native data science and ML platform for population health analytics. Key deliverables: (1) Azure ML or Databricks environment setup with MLOps pipeline, (2) predictive modelling for hospital readmission and ER wait-time forecasting, (3) Snowflake data warehouse for clinical data aggregation, (4) Power BI executive dashboards, (5) privacy-preserving analytics framework compliant with FOIPPA and PHIPA. The vendor must have demonstrated experience with health data in BC or Canadian federal contexts, Databricks certifications, and Python-based ML model development.

ground_truth.rationale: Excellent match — Databricks, Azure ML, Snowflake, Power BI, and ML modelling are Your Organization strengths. BC Ministry of Health is a high-value provincial client. Contract value ($1.2M) is large but within range. FOIPPA compliance adds risk but Your Organization has BC public sector experience.
